newsitem.title: FRANCE: GAN gets until Sept 15 to hold AGM.
newsitem.headline: GAN gets until Sept 15 to hold AGM.

text.p: French state insurer GAN said on Tuesday that it got court clearance to delay its annual general meeting pending to outcome of talks with the European Commission on a restructuring plan involving some 20 billion francs in state aid.
The annual general meeting was initially due to take place on June 30.
The insurer said the court extended the deadline for holding a meeting to September 15 at the latest and that it would call a meeting before that date.

The previous centre-right government unveiled the restructuring plan earlier this year, said it would seek approval from the European Commission and it hoped to privatise GAN this year. But the new left-wing government has yet to state its final position on the various privatisations planned by the former government.
